system.description:
Requirements: Expertise (1) in Dexterity

You excel at protecting your allies.

  • When you take the Defend an Ally action, your Defense increases by +1 until the start of your next turn.

  • Once per turn, when an ally within 5 spaces of you would be hit by a hostile attack, spell, or ability, you can immediately throw yourself in the way and take the hit instead.

    How you move depends on the range of the triggering attack, spell, or ability.

    • Melee / Touch: You must move beside your ally.

    • Ranged: You must move between your ally and the source of the triggering attack.
